title: GPU Programming for AI Workflow Development on AWS SageMaker: An Instructional Approach
problem: GPU programming education and practical experience with cloud platforms is limited; students need hands-on exposure to GPU architecture and AI agent development on realistic infrastructure.
motivation: AI and GPU computing are increasingly central to STEM; experiential cloud-based GPU education strengthens problem-solving skills and industry readiness.
method: Specialized course (Fall 2024-Spring 2025): GPU architecture fundamentals → GPU programming → RAG and AI agent development on AWS SageMaker. Evaluated via assessments, course surveys, TensorBoard/HPC profilers.
key_novelty: Comprehensive GPU+cloud pedagogical model integrating hardware concepts, parallel programming, and practical AI agent deployment.
contributions: Evidence that AWS SageMaker is economical platform for education
Experiential learning improves technical proficiency and critical thinking
primary_theme: GPU+cloud computing curriculum for STEM education
